description: Generate 3D content from text or images; these operations may cost credits.

identity.goal: Complete the generative 3d use case of blender using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the blender upstream of the blender-connector connector. The namespace `blender` is active by default; if the operator set lazy activation, activate it with registry_activate first. Every tool below is namespaced blender_<tool>. Work through these tools in order: `blender_generate_3d`, `blender_generate_gaussian_world`. Steps: (1) Describe the target model or world. (2) Run the generation and wait for progress. (3) Inspect the result and integrate it into the scene. Report a refusal payload when a tool refuses; never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the blender namespace was available before the first tool call
every tool named in this prompt exists in the upstream snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently
